# smtpfast_domain_verification (Resource)

Waits until a sending domain is verified, so the resources that send mail can `depends_on` it. Creating it asks SMTPfast to check the domain now (the dashboard's Verify button) and checks again, less often each time, until the domain is verified or the create timeout ends (30 minutes by default). On timeout the error lists each DNS record that SMTPfast does not see yet, with what it found instead.

Make it depend on the DNS records, so the first check runs after they exist. `verified` means the domain can send: DKIM and the email provider identity are verified. SPF, DMARC and MAIL FROM can still be pending; the domain's `spf_status`, `dmarc_status` and `mail_from_status` show them.

It checks once, when it is created; it does not follow the domain's status later. Destroying it changes nothing on SMTPfast.

Needs a provider API key with the `domain:read` and `domain:write` scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "smtpfast_domain" "example" {
  domain = "mail.example.com"
}

resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "smtpfast" {
  for_each = smtpfast_domain.example.records

  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  type     = each.value.type
  name     = each.value.name
  content  = each.value.value
  priority = each.value.priority
  ttl      = 1
  proxied  = false
}

# Checks after the records exist, then again until the domain is verified or
# the timeout ends. On timeout the error lists the records SMTPfast does not
# see yet.
resource "smtpfast_domain_verification" "example" {
  domain_id  = smtpfast_domain.example.id
  depends_on = [cloudflare_dns_record.smtpfast]

  timeouts {
    create = "30m"
  }
}

# Anything that sends mail can wait for it.
resource "smtpfast_api_key" "app" {
  name       = "app"
  scopes     = ["email:send"]
  depends_on = [smtpfast_domain_verification.example]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) ID of the `smtpfast_domain` to wait for. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) The domain name.
- `id` (String) The domain ID.
- `status` (String) `verified` once the wait is over.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
